title: Russia says at least seven killed in largest Ukrainian attack of 2026
description: Moscow also launched deadly strikes against Ukraine overnight, sparking fires across the capital Kyiv.

title: Watch: BBC visits smouldering market in Ukraine after strikes
description: Six people were injured in the strike on the market selling second-hand records, posters, toys and tools.

title: Emergency phone alert put domestic abuse victims at risk, campaigners say
description: The alert took many by surprise when it was sent to millions of phones on Friday night - but it may have also put vulnerable people at risk.
